adjudication.tie_policy: Use a tie only when both responses are eligible and neither has a material advantage on naturalness, ease, register, fidelity, or precision.

hard_gate_definitions.factual-fidelity: The response preserves every supplied fact, name, figure, date, condition, certainty level, attribution, and required term.
hard_gate_definitions.no-invention: The response invents no result, permission, route, quote, motive, anecdote, opinion, product behavior, or supporting fact.
hard_gate_definitions.ready-copy-only: The response returns only the requested article, with no rationale, audit, process note, change log, confidence note, recap, or invitation to continue.
hard_gate_definitions.plain-register-containment: For an ordinary audience, the response does not leak internal review, research, legal, or system vocabulary unless the reader needs the exact term.
hard_gate_definitions.canonical-house-style: Generated copy contains no canonical banned typography, vocabulary, connective, stock template, significance tail, or prompt leakage without an explicit immutable-text exception.
hard_gate_definitions.author-sample-no-copy: The response follows observable sample habits without copying a distinctive phrase, fact, example, metaphor, slogan, or anecdote.
hard_gate_definitions.user-instructions: The response follows the user's exact structure, position, ending, and style requirements.

cases.archetype: article with first-party event and decisions
cases.primary_outcome: Uses the supplied migration details to explain the lesson without invented results.
Useful, deliberate structure without invented supporting facts.
Keeps the requested sections, position, and ending.
Uses sample style without importing facts or overstating the pilot.
Uses ordinary retail language instead of internal review terms.
